description: Audio Download. Download audio from a URL via HuntAPI and receive a job id. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

audio_format.description: Desired output format for the audio. Default: "mp3".

download_type.description: Desired download type. Supported values: audio (default). Default: "audio".

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

max_duration.description: Maximum duration of the downloaded content in seconds. If the audio is longer than this value, only the content up to this duration will be downloaded.

webhook_authorization.description: Authorization header for the webhook. This parameter allows you to add authentication to your webhook endpoint.

webhook_url.description: URL of the webhook where results will be sent. When specified, the system will attempt to send the response to this URL up to 3 times with a 5-second delay between each attempt. The results will be sent as a POST request.

name: audio_download
title: Audio Download
